tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma kha shas kyi rnam par thar pa'i dkar chag/ 001 dmar chos kyi rgyal pos sa paṇa gyi gsung sgros bris pa lam 'bras bod kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje/ 002 'phags pa'i slob ma cha rgan gyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lo rgyus zur tsam brjod pa/ 003 lo tsā ba grags pa rtse mos mdzad pa'i chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba/ 004 kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter/ 005 rat+na saṃ bha was mdzad pa'i red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyi rnam thar/ 006 mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas rtse mos mdzad pa'i red mda' ba chen po gzhon nu blo gros kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung / 007 nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rong ston chen po'i rnam thar phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel bzang po zhes bya ba/ 008 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gis mdzad pa'i byams chen rab 'byams pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas 'phel gyi rnam thar dad gus chu 'dzin rnam par rol pa/ 009 grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi rtogs brjod dpal ldan bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam thar legs bshad gsum ldan/ 010 sde gzhung sprul sku byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i sde gzhung sprul sku 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 011 bde mchog lū hi pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ shar pa chen po rdo rje 'od zer gyis mdzad pa/ 012 skyes mchog rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba/ sgrol ma kha'i dang / dz+nyā na shrīs mdzad pa/ 013 rje btsun rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rnam par thar pa don gyi snying po bsdus pa/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ 014 red mda' ba'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung /

mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas rtse mos mdzad pa/ 015 chos rje rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam thar/ dpal ldan chos skyong gis mdzad pa/ 016 kun mkhyen dwags po ba bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gyi rgya mtsho/ dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta karma phrin las kyis mdzad pa/ 017 rje btsun zhwa lu lo tsā ba'i rnam par thar pa brjed byang nor bu'i khri shing / dpal rin chen bkra shis kyis mdzad pa/ 018 dpal sa skya lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam par thar pa 'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan rnam par bkod pa/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun 'grub kyis mdzad pa/ 019 dpal ldan bla ma dkon mchog bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed/ blo gros rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ 020 kha che paṇa chen gyi rnam thar rin po che'i phreng ba/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa gzhis bcas pa/ 021 pan grub gsum gyi rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing / 022 mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i rnam thar/ 023 bla ma skyer sgang pa'i rnam thar dang / gsang rnam gnyis/ 024 dpal ldan bla ma rmog cog pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa//
